chain.g: snake; serpent (any reptile of the suborder Serpentes)

ety.text: Borrowed from Portuguese cobra, from Latin colubra (“a female snake”).

senses.d: Any of the genus Naja of venomous snakes that can spread their neck ribs into a broad hood when threatened; a true cobra.
A ring-necked spitting cobra or rinkhals (Hemachatus haemachatus).
A false water cobra, Hydrodynastes gigas.
A type of lanyard knot, thought to resemble a snake in its shape.
